decision.reason: [ev-21e07cf98d97] gives the subject (ipcache high-scale mode) and the change: it is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in v1.18. It does not name the config option, flag, Helm value or other setting that turns this mode on. Without that, nobody can write an applicability condition that tells which environments are exposed. We need evidence that identifies the setting that enables high-scale ipcache mode, such as the option reference or the PR that deprecates it.
